value.rationale: One-edge barbells are a canonical bridge-of-cliques family. The exact characterization of every zero forcing set exposes how a cut edge interacts with dense clique classes and yields the full counting polynomial and all optimal configurations for unequal clique sizes. This is a natural complete classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice or a recomputation of a known table.
